Messages.Author: XZealot
Messages.Body:
If a minion manuevers with a gun then the opposing minion steals the
gun with a superior fast hands, is that minion still committed to
striking with the gun that round? Is he still committed to striking
with the gun if he performs additional strikes that round?

Comments Welcome,
Norman S. Brown, Jr
XZealot
Archon of the Swamp

Messages.Author: Emmit Svenson
Messages.Body:
XZealot wrote:
> If a minion manuevers with a gun then the opposing minion steals the
> gun with a superior fast hands, is that minion still committed to
> striking with the gun that round?

Yes. No initial strike for that minion as a result.

> Is he still committed to striking
> with the gun if he performs additional strikes that round?

No, nor would he be if he hadn't had the gun stolen. Only the initial
strike must be from the gun he maneuvered with.
